name: DTMAPI 大视野
author: Yuuka
description: 依赖 DTMAPI Runtime。按 + / - 调整大视野，基于 DTMAPI CameraView / GameBridge 能力，不缩放 UI。

localized_description.schinese: 依赖 DTMAPI Runtime。按 + / - 调整世界相机视野，最小为原版，最大默认 400%。基于 DTMAPI CameraView / GameBridge 能力，UI 缩放和点击坐标保持原样。
localized_description.tchinese: 依賴 DTMAPI Runtime。按 + / - 調整世界相機視野，最小為原版，最大預設 400%。基於 DTMAPI CameraView / GameBridge 能力，UI 縮放和點擊座標保持原樣。
localized_description.english: Requires DTMAPI Runtime. Press + / - to adjust the world camera view from vanilla up to 400% by default. Built on DTMAPI CameraView/GameBridge and leaves UI scale and click mapping untouched.
